questions.question: Why did the French-speaking community in Brussels accept equal representation in the capital city's government?

Because the Dutch community agreed to pay all national income taxes
Because Brussels was placed under direct rule of the German monarchy

questions.subtopic: Comparing Belgium and Sri Lanka Lessons
questions.question: What fundamental comparative political lesson do the contrasting experiences of Belgium and Sri Lanka teach modern democracies?
options: A majority community must forcefully suppress all linguistic minorities to achieve rapid economic growth
Small nations should never adopt democratic constitutions
Unity of the nation is possible only by respecting the feelings and interests of different communities and regions
Countries with multiple languages must immediately partition into tiny sovereign states
questions.explanation: Belgium showed that national unity is possible only by respecting the feelings and interests of different communities. Sri Lanka showed that if a majority community forces its dominance over others and refuses to share power, it can undermine the unity of the nation.
